title: Placement: Leaders in an Array
description: An element is a leader if it is strictly greater than or equal to all elements to its right. The rightmost element is always a leader. Given an array `arr`, return all leaders in their original relative order.
constraints:
1 <= len(arr) <= 10^5
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1) auxiliary
explanation: Scanning from right to left maintains the maximum element seen so far in O(N) time.
